methods.notes: Renogy BT modules advertise a name beginning "BT-TH-". A client needs the module's MAC, an alias and the Modbus device_id to talk to it.

device.manufacturer: Renogy (Rover/Wanderer/Adventurer controllers; SRNE / Rich Solar rebadges)
device.name: Renogy BT-1 / BT-2 Solar Charge Controllers
device.notes:
Renogy's BT-1 (RS232 bridge) and BT-2 (RS485 bridge) modules plug into a Renogy charge controller / battery / inverter and expose it over BLE. Control is Modbus RTU frames tunneled over GATT — no cloud, no account. Reads (and, for some devices, writes) work locally; only one BLE client at a time (the Renogy app vs a third-party client).
GATT: write characteristic 0000ffd1-0000-1000-8000-00805f9b34fb; notify characteristic 0000fff1-0000-1000-8000-00805f9b34fb.
FRAMING: standard Modbus RTU. Example read request (Rover): bytes [255, 3, 1, 0, 0, 34, 209, 241] = device address 255, function 0x03, start register 0x0100, 34 words, CRC16. Standalone devices answer at Modbus address 255; in multi-device "hub" mode, controllers are 96-97, batteries 48-50, the inverter broadcast is 32.
ROVER/WANDERER REGISTERS (from RoverClient):
  reg 12  x8 words  model / function string
  reg 26  x1        device (Modbus) address
  reg 256 (0x0100) x34 words  MAIN TELEMETRY: battery %, voltage, current,
          temperature; controller temperature; load status/voltage/current/
          power; PV voltage/current/power; daily + total generation/
          consumption; charging status (mppt/boost/floating)
  reg 57348 (0xE004) x1  battery type (open/sealed/gel/lithium/custom)

openness.notes: No official protocol publication; cyrils/renogy-bt documents the GATT + Modbus usage and multiple implementations (incl. an ESPHome port) agree for the Rover class. Battery/inverter register layouts vary by model.

credentials.notes: No pairing/auth documented. Reads are open; writes change controller configuration and should be treated as advanced.
stored_on_device: Controller configuration (battery type, limits) via Modbus registers

factory_reset.effect: No documented BLE factory reset for the module; controller settings are changed via Modbus writes to the config registers, not a single reset.

methods.description: Connect to the "BT-TH-" module, subscribe to the notify characteristic (0xFFF1), and write Modbus RTU read requests to the write characteristic (0xFFD1). Read register 0x0100 (34 words) for the main telemetry block.

steps.action: Plug the BT-1/BT-2 module into the controller's comms port.
Connect over BLE, subscribe to 0xFFF1, write a Modbus read of 0x0100 to 0xFFD1.

setup.notes: Nothing to provision beyond plugging the BT module into the controller's RJ12/RJ45 port. Connect over BLE and issue Modbus reads. Only one BLE client can be connected at a time.

rejoin.notes: No network membership; a new BLE client connects independently (one at a time).

testing.notes: Not driven against hardware by this project. GATT UUIDs, the Modbus-over- BLE framing and the Rover register block are from cyrils/renogy-bt.

characteristics.name: Write (Modbus request)
characteristics.notes: Modbus RTU read/write requests written here (e.g. read 0x0100 x34).

services.name: Renogy BT module service
services.notes: Write Modbus RTU requests to 0xFFD1; responses arrive on the notify characteristic 0xFFF1. Frames are standard Modbus RTU with CRC16.
